Hi Alison. Thanks for sending over the full list of free times for Priya and Marcus. I've carefully compared their schedules with Elena's and David's, but it appears there are no 30-minute slots where all four partners are available next week.

I've double-checked my work, and the schedules don't seem to align. Perhaps we could propose a few of the "closest" times and see if one of the partners is able to reschedule something? For example, on Thursday at 10:00, only Elena Soto is busy. Or on Thursday at 14:30, only Marcus Hale is busy.

Let me know what you think.
